articles.title: Half of UK wealth advisers say clients' crypto is ‘invisible’ to them: CoinShares survey
articles.snippet: A CoinShares survey found than many EU-based wealth management companies had policies that restricted investments in digital assets or provided no guidance on the matter.

articles.title: About 60% of World Cup bettors on Polymarket are first-time crypto users
articles.snippet: Polymarket emerged as an onboarding layer for about 60% of World Cup bettors, who interacted with the blockchain for the first time during their prediction market entry.

articles.title: Polish crypto exchange Kanga secures MiCA license in Latvia
articles.snippet: Poland-founded crypto exchange Kanga has secured a Class 3 MiCA license in Latvia, enabling EU-wide crypto services as Polish lawmakers debate framework's implementation.

articles.title: AI Took Your Job? California Wants to Know
articles.snippet: California launched the nation's first AI unemployment tracker as policymakers race to determine whether warnings of an AI-driven jobs shakeup are becoming a reality.

articles.title: $47M in Crypto Frozen in Global Infostealer Takedown: Europol
articles.snippet: Police disrupted SocGholish, Amadey, and StealC, malware that harvests crypto wallets and passwords, freezing €41 million in crypto.
